_meta.purpose: External command-line tools the data-preparation scripts need, grouped by what stops working without them. Public reference data: no personal information here.
_meta.why: Every ingest script checks its own tools and stops with a hint when one is missing. That is correct behaviour and terrible timing: on the genome path the gap surfaces an hour into an alignment. This file exists so the whole picture can be shown before anything starts.
_meta.names: The binary and the package are often not the same name — bgzip and tabix both come from htslib, uvx comes from uv — and a list of binaries cannot be handed to a package manager. That mapping is the point of this file.
_meta.unverified: Where a package name has not been verified against the tool's own documentation, it is absent deliberately. Printing an install command that turns out to be wrong costs more than printing none: the person runs it, it fails, and now they distrust the rest of the list.
_meta.sudo: No entry here needs administrator rights, and that is a selection criterion rather than a coincidence. Homebrew and conda install into the user's own prefix. Anything that would need sudo is shown as text for the person to run themselves.
_meta.sets: A set names the tools it REQUIRES. Anything that merely makes the step faster or better is listed under `optional` and never counted as missing: a set that looks complete while a required tool is absent is worse than no list at all.

why.en: Without these the genome layer does not work at all: a VCF can be neither read, nor indexed, nor filtered.
why.ru: Без них геномный слой не работает вовсе: VCF нельзя ни прочитать, ни проиндексировать, ни отфильтровать.

why.en: Without a coverage measurement 'no findings' says nothing: a gene read at 70 % gives the same zero as a gene read in full. samtools alone can do it, more slowly.
why.ru: Без измерения покрытия «находок нет» не означает ничего: ген, прочитанный на 70 %, даёт такой же ноль, как прочитанный целиком. samtools справится и один, только медленнее.

why.en: PyPGx and PharmCAT resolve diplotypes — the level at which CYP2D6 copy number and phase can be read at all.

would_close.en: CYP2D6 star alleles from a VCF. This build resolves CYP2D6 only from a called diplotype produced elsewhere (PyPGx from a BAM); from a plain provider VCF, and from every consumer array, CYP2D6 has no phenotype at all — both of its tag SNPs are absent from the 23andMe v5 chip, measured. That gap decides codeine, tramadol, tamoxifen and the tricyclics.
would_close.ru: Звёздные аллели CYP2D6 из VCF. Сейчас CYP2D6 разрешается только по вызванному диплотипу, полученному снаружи (PyPGx из BAM); по обычному VCF провайдера и по любому потребительскому чипу фенотипа у CYP2D6 нет вовсе — оба его тег-SNP отсутствуют на чипе 23andMe v5, измерено. Этот пробел решает кодеин, трамадол, тамоксифен и трициклики.

why_named_not_taken.en: Licence-compatible (MIT) and the right tool, unlike Aldy and Cyrius whose licences forbid it. Integrating a caller is a pipeline change with its own install, not a data edit, so it is named here rather than half-done: a tool listed as available and not actually reachable is the failure this file exists to prevent.
why_named_not_taken.ru: Совместим по лицензии (MIT) и подходит по существу, в отличие от Aldy и Cyrius, чьи лицензии это запрещают. Подключение вызывателя — изменение конвейера со своей установкой, а не правка данных, поэтому он здесь назван, а не сделан наполовину: инструмент, объявленный доступным и недостижимый на деле, — ровно тот дефект, против которого этот файл и существует.
